description: Rajasthan government unveiled the iStart Learning Management System, Rajasthan AVGC-XR Portal, and the Rajasthan AI Portal, aimed at boosting AI-driven education, startups, research, skill development and digital governance in the state.
body_lead: Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma on Tuesday launched the Rajasthan Artificial Intelligence-Machine Learning (AI-ML) Policy 2026 and the National AI Literacy Programme. The policies were launched at the inaugural of the Rajasthan Regional AI Impact Conference-2026 at the Jaipur Exhibition and Convention Centre (JECC). Sharma also unveiled the iStart Learning Management System, Rajasthan AVGC-XR Portal, and the Rajasthan AI Portal, aimed at boosting AI-driven education, startups, research, skill development and digital governance in the state.
